cases.name: Victoria Gazzam
cases.narrative: He punched her to death because she wouldn't stop crying. The doctor who performed the baby’s autopsy told the court the baby had multiple contusions to her back and head, a lacerated kidney and heart vessel, fractured ribs, and a brain bleed.  The doctor also discovered some chronic injuries to Victoria’s arms that were likely from repeated twisting.
